development.subject: Databricks connector cannot connect
development.description: A newly configured Databricks warehouse connector cannot establish a connection. It has never worked and the error gives no authentication details.
development.rationale: Unfamiliar warehouse connector; no historical transport mechanism established.

development.subject: Password recovery message missing
development.description: I requested a password reset but never received the email, including in spam. I cannot even open a reset link.
development.rationale: Delivery missing rather than rejected password after receiving/resetting.

development.subject: New password does not work
development.description: I received the password reset email, followed the link and changed the password, but login rejects the new password as incorrect.

development.subject: Subscription paid twice
development.description: There are two identical card charges for a single monthly subscription payment.
development.rationale: Duplicate monthly charge rather than seat-count discrepancy.

development.subject: Too many requests at normal volume
development.description: Our integration now gets HTTP 429 rate limit errors although its usage has not changed.

development.subject: Ordinary API activity is being throttled
development.description: Requests that normally succeed are being limited as excessive traffic. We are not sending more requests than before.
development.rationale: Rate limiting paraphrase without exact numeric code.

development.subject: Existing HubSpot sync no longer signs in
development.description: The HubSpot integration ran successfully for months but has just started returning an authentication error.

development.subject: New Redshift authentication error
development.description: Our newly set up Redshift integration rejects authentication on its first connection attempt.
development.rationale: Different connector and first-use failure; no evidence historical expired-credential incident applies.

development.subject: Revenue chart is empty
development.description: The revenue chart renders a white rectangle with no bars or axis labels.
development.rationale: Blank chart rendering not login redirect.

development.subject: Blank app after SSO
development.description: After authenticating through Okta SSO, the redirect returns a completely blank application page.
development.rationale: SSO redirect blankness, distinct from chart rendering.

development.subject: Two-factor code not delivered
development.description: SMS verification messages never arrive on my phone when I try to log in with two-factor authentication.
development.rationale: Missing SMS 2FA, not password email delivery.

development.subject: Email verification code missing
development.description: Our login verification code sent by email is never delivered. This account uses email verification, not text messages.
development.rationale: No historical email-code delivery mechanism; SMS incident is a different channel.

development.subject: Wrong invoice headcount
development.description: Our invoice lists 25 seats even though we only have 18 active users.
development.rationale: Seat overcount instead of duplicate payment.

development.subject: Recent transaction data absent
development.description: The newest transaction records are missing after the nightly sync and are also absent from the CSV export.
development.rationale: Both linked recent-data symptoms apply; tests multi-ID recall.

development.subject: Long PDF export fails
development.description: Exporting a full year as a PDF report times out after roughly thirty seconds.
development.rationale: PDF rendering timeout, not peak queue delays.

development.subject: Morning scheduled reports delayed
development.description: During peak morning usage the scheduled reports arrive several hours late.
development.rationale: Delayed, not entirely missing scheduled report.

fresh.subject: Two payments for one subscription month
fresh.description: Our credit card shows the same subscription amount deducted twice this month, although we only have one monthly plan.

fresh.subject: Integration is unexpectedly throttled
fresh.description: An unchanged integration is receiving HTTP 429 responses during its usual daily workload.

fresh.subject: Reset completed but sign-in fails
fresh.description: The reset email arrived and I chose a new password through its link. The login form still reports that password is incorrect.
fresh.rationale: Post-reset rejection, preserving a valid neighbor of missing-mail query.

fresh.subject: Invited employee has no dashboards
fresh.description: A newly invited colleague can sign in but the dashboard list is empty without any error.
fresh.rationale: Successful login with missing permissions, not chart rendering.

fresh.subject: Viewer can rearrange the shared dashboard
fresh.description: A teammate assigned read-only viewer access is still able to drag and rearrange dashboard widgets.

fresh.subject: Yearly PDF generation times out
fresh.description: Trying to download a full year PDF report ends in a timeout around the thirty-second mark.

fresh.subject: HubSpot stopped authenticating
fresh.description: After several months of working, our HubSpot data integration now fails with an authentication error.

fresh.subject: Previous API credential remains usable
fresh.description: We generated a replacement API key but requests signed with the prior key still succeed.

fresh.subject: Recovery link never delivered
fresh.description: I asked for password recovery twice today. There is no reset email in my inbox or junk folder and I have not received a reset link.

fresh.subject: New Athena connector handshake failure
fresh.description: Our first attempt to connect a new Athena warehouse fails during the connection handshake. No authentication error is reported.
fresh.rationale: Unfamiliar connector, transport failure instead of known authentication incident.

fresh.subject: Password recovery text is missing
fresh.description: The password recovery flow promises a reset link by SMS but no text message arrives. This is not a two-factor login code.
fresh.rationale: SMS channel alone does not establish two-factor verification incident.

fresh.subject: Checkout returns HTTP 500
fresh.description: The checkout web page returns a server error whenever I try to buy an annual subscription. This is not an integration API request.
fresh.rationale: A shared status code does not establish the API optional-parameter failure.

fresh.subject: Unable to open application
fresh.description: It does not work. I do not have an error message or any other details yet.
fresh.rationale: Insufficient evidence to identify historical mechanism.

fresh.subject: New CRM connector DNS error
fresh.description: We just configured a connector for a new CRM and its hostname cannot be resolved by DNS.
